description: Create a private single-use link that quotes the customer's own model (STL, OBJ, STEP, STP, 3MF, up to 5 MB) without the file passing through the chat. Use it when the file isn't a native attachment and you can't send its exact bytes; for a ChatGPT file attachment, use printing.quotes.create. Returns the link, a shell upload command and an upload panel for the customer. Expires in 30 minutes and makes one quote. Then call printing.uploads.get.

accessToken.description: Guest token from printing.sessions.start. Omit when it is sent as a Bearer header.

materialId.description: Material ID from printing.capabilities.get. Defaults to black_pla. Changing it reprices the quote and needs fresh approval.

name: printing.uploads.create

upload.description: Single-use upload link, its expiry and how to deliver the file.

title: Create Model Upload Link
